Since 2026-10-09 most work is generated homework (tools/agents/homework.py from docs/agents/roles.json; docs/agents/RESEARCH_LOOP.md): this file keeps only what cannot be computed from the data (work in progress, code reviews, guides, music, motion, onboarding). tasks.title: Varieties to look for at the pro-photo session (every US, UK and German coin in a flip)
tasks.what: Phase 2 will photograph every coin with a loupe. Before that session, list for every US, UK and German coin in a flip (data/index.json, by id) each KNOWN variety or error for that exact year and mint that a collector would pay more for: e.g. 1982 small vs large date cents, 1983/1984 doubled-die Lincoln cents, 1970-S small date, 1999/2000 wide vs close AM, 1995 DDO, UK 2008 undated 20p mule, German 1950-G 'BANK DEUTSCHER LÄNDER' 50 pfennig. For each: what to look for, on which side, how big a loupe it needs, and the value if found with an exact price source. Send varieties_grok_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json as [{"id": "C0xx", "type": "...", "year": 1982, "mint": "D", "variety": "...", "look_for": "...", "side": "obv|rev", "value_if_found_usd": 0, "source": "exact URL + row"}]. Leave a coin out when its year and mint have no known variety; never claim this coin IS the variety (only the photo can say).
tasks.done_when: One file in reviews-incoming; Claude turns it into the Phase 2 shoot checklist (fix list #61).
